Customer terms Customer privacy Vendor terms Vendor privacy

These Terms of Use govern access to the Queueless vendor web and mobile tools operated in Kenya (“Queueless”, “we”, “us”). They apply to the business and to the person who creates or uses the vendor account. By creating an account or using the vendor tools, you agree to these terms. People who join a queue as customers are covered by the separate customer terms.

1. Who we are

Queueless is a queue and booking platform. Vendors use it to publish a business, run live queues, take walk-ins, and manage bookings. Queueless does not provide the underlying service the business offers its customers.

2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old and able to act for the business you register. You must provide a valid Kenyan mobile number and keep the business and branch details accurate.

3. Your account

  • You are responsible for keeping your 4-digit PIN confidential and for activity under your account.
  • You must not share the account in a way that lets someone impersonate the business, or create an account for a business you do not represent.
  • We may suspend or deactivate accounts that abuse the service, attempt fraud, or violate these terms. A deactivated account can no longer sign in. The business listing can remain published.

4. Queues, walk-ins, and bookings

  • You control your services, branches, opening, and whether a queue is paused. Wait estimates shown to customers are based on the information you provide and can change.
  • Joining a queue or holding a booking does not guarantee an exact service time. You are responsible for the service you actually provide.
  • When you add a walk-in, you are responsible for the name, phone number, and party size you enter, and for having a proper reason to hold that information.
  • Customers can book up to 14 days ahead where you offer booking.

5. Testing

The current vendor testing period is free. We will tell you before any charge applies. A trial end date, where one is set on the account, does not by itself create a fee.

6. Acceptable use

You agree not to misuse Queueless, including by disrupting the service, entering false customer details, sending messages people did not ask for, scraping data without permission, or using the platform for unlawful purposes under Kenyan law.

7. Service availability

We aim to keep Queueless available, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted access. Maintenance, network issues, or third-party outages (for example SMS delivery) may affect the service.

8. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by Kenyan law, Queueless is not liable for delays, missed appointments, or losses arising from how you run your queue, the estimates shown to customers, or circumstances outside our reasonable control. Nothing in these terms excludes liability for fraud or for death or personal injury caused by our negligence where such exclusion is not allowed.

9. Changes

We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the vendor tools after changes are posted on this page constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

10. Contact

Questions about these terms can be sent to hello@queueless.co.ke.
